text:
rina: Quick sync 0min019: planning newsletter + drip for benchmark release + webinar. primary KPIs: webinar RSVPs, benchmark downloads, demo clicks.
lucas: propose 3-segment funnel: ENG (API heavy), PM (product leads), ACQ (content subscribers). each gets tailored subject + 1st-line personalization.
maya: creative: hero variants A/B (engineer screenshot) vs B (chart: cost/latency). i'll produce 600x300 and 1200x628.
jen: subject ideas (short):
- "New benchmark: LLM inference costs sliced"
- "See how teams halved per-token cost"
- "Live demo + benchmark walkthrough (RSVP)"
preheaders: "Join our live Q&A" / "Benchmark + cost optimization tips".
aj: segmentation logic (SQL snippets):
```
-- ENG: tags include 'api:active' and last_30d_calls > 5
-- PM: role:product OR topic:ops AND opened_last_90d > 0
-- ACQ: subscribed AND opens_last_30d <=1
```
maya: we'll A/B test personal first line vs generic. recommend 40/40/20 split for ENG (two headlines + holdout).
lucas: deliverability notes: use warmed dedicated IP pool, exclude 'unsub' and 'do-not-contact', suppress webinar attendees from last 90d. throttle 900/min.
ops-bot: ESP status: SendGrid pool "sprint-newsletter-2" active, warmness 88%.
jen: CTA path: primary CTA -> register for webinar. post-reg email includes benchmark link + calendar invite. secondary CTA in launch email -> "Request demo" (track with demo_link param).
aj: tracking: utm_campaign=bench_launch_q2; utm_content=segment_variant. attach event tags: "email:bench_q2", "channel:webinar".
maya: creative deadline: thumbnails + hero mockups by Tue noon. copy drafts pushed: https://docs.redwood.ai/mkt/bench/q2-email-drafts
rina: schedule: warm segment Tue 9am PT, PM/ENG stagger Wed 10am PT, ACQ Thu 11am PT. send cadence: launch -> 5d reminder -> 2d before -> last-hour.
lucas: matrix test: 3 subjects x 2 preheaders x 2 send times = 12 combos, limit to ENG + PM. ACQ gets simpler test (subject + send time).
jen: approval gate: product (aj), legal (legal@redwood.ai), deliverability (lucas). need approvals by Mon EOD to hit Tue.
aj: will QA audience Wed AM. include seed list: rina, lucas, jen, aj, maya + 5 customer test emails.
maya: asset path: /marketing/assets/bench_q2/ (I'll drop optimized PNGs + webp).
lucas: note: add suppression to prevent duplicate sends if user in multiple segments same day. also set retry policy for ESP 5xx with exponential backoff.
rina: cadence for inbound: webinar registrants -> calendar invite + 24hr reminder + 1hr before. non-attendees -> post webinar: benchmark download + demo CTA.
jen: small copy tweak: swap "token costs" -> "per-token cost" across variants B.
ops-bot: automation check: calendar invites flow mapped, demo booking redirect live.
rina: blockers?
lucas: none.
maya: none.
aj: none.
rina: great. reconvene Mon after approvals. thanks :tada:
